messages:
talia: starting promotion for metrics-proxy (chart 3.2.0 -> 3.3.0). Heads-up: this one touches envoy config and rollout window overlaps with partner maintenance at 23:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: promotion scheduled. Canary will run in us-east with 15% traffic. Preflight checks: image digest present, no CRD changes.
max: flag — partner maintenance means we should avoid full rollout until their window ends. Do we have a way to pin canary-only release and delay full promotion?
product-eng: we need the new config for a latency fix, but can do canary first and hold full promotion until after partner window. Release notes must mention the deferred full rollout.
release-manager: plan: run canary, then set `release.redwood.io/hold-promotion-until=2026-03-22T23:30:00Z` annotation on HelmRelease to block auto-promote. If canary looks good after 60m, we'll notify partner and then lift hold.
sre_oncall: ensure we have rollback steps and that the hold annotation doesn't prevent emergency rollbacks.
infra: hold annotation semantics: deploy-bot respects `hold-promotion-until` and will not promote beyond canary until timestamp passes or manual clear. Emergency rollback still allowed.
talia: running canary now with fraction 0.15. Command:
```
kubectl -n prod annotate helmrelease metrics-proxy \
  release.redwood.io/canary-fraction=0.15 --overwrite
deploy-bot promote --chart metrics-proxy --rev 3.3.0 --canary
```
deploy-bot: canary started. Monitoring window 60m. Metrics pipeline enabled. Incident token created: canary-metricsproxy-1766664321.
max: initial canary p95 at baseline, no errors at 5m. Good signal. Will keep an eye on envoy histograms.
product-eng: updating release notes: "Canary deployed; full promotion held until partner maintenance completes to avoid overlapping config change. If canary passes, full rollout will occur post-23:30 UTC with partner notification."
release-manager: applying hold annotation now to prevent auto-promotion:
```
kubectl -n prod annotate helmrelease metrics-proxy \
  release.redwood.io/hold-promotion-until=2026-03-22T23:30:00Z --overwrite
```
infra: hold annotation applied. Auto-promotion blocked.
sre_oncall: adding quick rollback commands in incident: `helm rollback metrics-proxy <prev-rev>` and `kubectl annotate helmrelease metrics-proxy release.redwood.io/hold-promotion-until-removed=true` to clear hold after manual check.
talia: canary at 30m looks stable. No increase in 5xx or latency.
max: small tail spike at 27m but traced to an unrelated backend retry loop, not this chart. Marked in observability.
product-eng: thanks — will coordinate with partner about lifting hold. Sending note now.
release-manager: partner acked and asked for a runbook pointer. I've added link to RDW-612 (partner-rollout-playbook) in release notes.
infra: when lifting hold, we'll annotate `release.redwood.io/hold-promotion-until=false` and then trigger `deploy-bot promote --chart metrics-proxy --target all-regions`. Confirming manual step required to avoid accidental promotion.
release-manager: scheduling manual promotion at 23:35 UTC if partner remains green. Adding one-line to changelog: "Full promotion scheduled post-partner maintenance; canary passed 60m window."
sre_oncall: monitoring 60m complete; no regressions. Standby for manual promotion.
talia: thanks team. If anything regresses we rollback immediately and unpin any chart digest we've set.
deploy-bot: canary complete and healthy. Reminder: to rollback: `helm rollback metrics-proxy 2 --namespace prod`. To remove hold and promote: `kubectl annotate helmrelease metrics-proxy release.redwood.io/hold-promotion-until=false --overwrite && deploy-bot promote --chart metrics-proxy --target all-regions`. Incident closed pending manual promote.
